| [ADR-116](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-116.md) v2 | Work merges into a staging branch through pull requests, and a Promote workflow merges staging into main nightly or on demand, concretizing a batch's temporary codes at once and merging main back; so units cite each other's codes without stacking, and the tooling fits how the work is done | The owner, 2026-11-21: stacked pull requests mean waiting for a CI run on each merge; "maybe a better solution would be to keep CI on main as it is, but have our regular work merge into an intermediate branch like staging branch, which we can then manually merge into main if we feel like it's ready … and add a nightly job to merge any dangling staged work into main", with the philosophy "to fit the tooling to accomodate the way we're doing the work rather than vice versa". Work branches are cut from staging and merge into it; a Promote workflow merges staging into main, runs docs-generate's repair, views and concretization on the batch, lints, and merges main back into staging. First application: the six-PR stack of 2026-11-20 and 21 folded into staging. | Proposed |
